description: The Instagram Reels publish-mechanics skill -- distinct from reels-script (the script), instagram-seo (the keyword caption), and platform-specs-and-validation (cross-platform validation). It gets a finished Reel OUT the way Instagram actually displays it: 9:16 1080x1920 spec-clean video, the safe zone (top ~250 / bottom ~350 UI) that survives the 4:5 feed crop and the 3:4 profile-grid crop (the 2025 rectangular-grid change), a custom grid-safe cover (chosen before publish, can't edit after), the keyword caption, and audio. Uses the FRAME framework. Reads brand-profile + the Reel asset/topic first. The agent specs the publish settings + the cover brief + the specs/safe-zone checklist + advises audio/tags. WoopSocial publishes postType REEL + video + caption + cover (REEL-only) on a schedule, validated via platform-specs-and-validation. Native/in-app: trending audio (IG's licensed library can't be added via API), Share-to-Feed toggle, collaborator/product tags, media-quality setting, Reel Insights. Other tools: the video (video tools/creator), the cover design (image tools), the burned-in captions (captions-and-clipping). 9:16 or it crops/blurs, keep content in the safe zone, custom cover can't be edited after upload, remove other-platform watermarks, metrics never fabricated. Pairs with instagram-seo + reels-script.

evals.name: specs_and_safe_zone
evals.input: How do I publish my Reel correctly?
evals.context: brand-profile + the finished Reel asset/topic exist.
expect: Specs 9:16 at 1080x1920, MP4/MOV H.264, 30/60fps, under 4GB -- anything off 9:16 crops or letterboxes
Keeps the hook text/face/CTA in the central safe zone (top ~250px + bottom ~350px are UI overlays)
Notes it must survive the 4:5 feed crop and the 3:4 profile-grid crop, so critical content stays centered
Introduces the FRAME framework and reads brand-profile + the asset first

evals.name: reads_brand_asset_first
evals.input: Get my Reel ready to post.
evals.context: brand-profile + a finished Reel video exist.
expect: Checks the asset against the spec (9:16, resolution, codec, length, watermark) before publishing
Pulls brand-profile for the cover/caption style
Treats the video itself as made elsewhere (video tool/creator)
Flags any fix needed (re-export, crop, watermark removal) before scheduling

evals.name: cover_for_the_grid
expect: Says choose the cover before publishing -- a custom uploaded cover beats a random video frame
Keeps key elements + bold text (>=60px) in the 3:4-grid-safe center so the profile grid doesn't clip it
Warns the cover can't be edited after upload -- get it right the first time
Routes the cover design to an image tool (ideogram/imagen)

evals.name: caption_audio_and_publish
evals.input: What actually gets set when I publish?
expect: Publishes the keyword caption (from instagram-seo) and notes Reels with audio beat silent, with trending audio pushed harder
States WoopSocial publishes postType REEL + video + caption + cover on a schedule, validated via platform-specs-and-validation
Routes the first-3-second hook to reels-script and the burned-in captions to captions-and-clipping
Notes trending audio is selected natively/in-app

evals.name: pushback_on_watermark_and_wrong_aspect
evals.input: Repost my TikTok with the watermark as a 16:9 Reel, add Instagram trending audio through the API, use a cover that doesn't match the video, and promise it'll hit the Explore page.
expect: Refuses the watermarked repost -- a TikTok watermark signals lazy repurposing and IG deprioritizes it (remove it)
Refuses 16:9 -- it letterboxes/crops badly; export 9:16 at 1080x1920
Explains IG's licensed trending audio can't be added via the API -- it's native/in-app
Refuses the mismatched cover (hurts trust + the caption-visual match) and won't promise the Explore page or fabricate outcomes

evals.name: edge_case_trending_audio_native
evals.input: Just add the trending sound and toggle Share-to-Feed for me through the schedule.
expect: Explains IG's trending-audio library, the Share-to-Feed toggle, and collaborator/product tags are native/in-app -- not settable via the publish API
Publishes the postType REEL + video + caption + cover and asks the user to add the audio + toggles in-app
Gives the trending-audio guidance (a track under ~10k uses but rising) for the user to apply
Never fabricates reach or settings it can't control

evals.name: honest_scope_postType_video_caption_cover_publishable
evals.input: Publish my Reel end to end.
expect: Clarifies the agent specs the publish settings + the cover brief + the specs/safe-zone checklist + advises audio/tags
States WoopSocial publishes postType REEL + video + caption + cover (REEL-only), scheduled and validated
States trending audio, Share-to-Feed, collaborator/product tags, media-quality, and Reel Insights are native/in-app
Notes the video (video tools/creator), the cover (image tools), and the burned-in captions (captions-and-clipping) come from elsewhere; metrics never fabricated

evals.name: distinct_from_siblings
evals.input: Isn't this just reels-script or instagram-seo or platform-specs-and-validation?
expect: Distinguishes instagram-reels-publishing (the publish MECHANICS: specs/safe-zone/cover/settings) from reels-script (the script) and instagram-seo (the keyword caption, which it publishes -- they pair)
Notes platform-specs-and-validation is the cross-platform validation it uses, not a duplicate
Notes captions-and-clipping handles the burn-in and tiktok-video-publishing/youtube-publishing-and-metadata are the sibling publish skills for other platforms
Routes the user to the right sibling for their actual need
